comments.body: Validate that percent is a Decimal between 0 and 100 when the code is created, not when it is applied, so invalid codes cannot exist.
discount() should quantize before it is subtracted, otherwise total() can differ from subtotal - discount + tax by one cent.
Add a test for a code used exactly on its expiry date to pin down whether the date is inclusive.
Normalise code identifiers to upper case so 'save10' and 'SAVE10' are the same code.
